items.Sentence: The new WRF will replace the existing WWTP with a membrane bioreactor (MBR) wastewater treatment facility that will produce tertiary treated effluent that exceeds secondary standards for discharge.
Screened effluent and return activated sludge will flow into two biological nutrient removal (BNR) basins and then pumped to the MBR.
The BNR-MBR basins will be configured as two parallel activated sludge treatment trains, each consisting of pre-anoxic, aerobic, and post-anoxic basins in-series.

Raw wastewater will be conveyed to the Facility headworks, which will include two coarse screen and grit removal trains, a SAFE system box, and two parallel fine screens.
